findings.text: `source < existing_source` compares `ParameterSource` members. In click this is a plain `enum.Enum` with no ordering, so the comparison raises `TypeError`. It runs whenever a second parameter shares a name with one already processed, for example a feature-switch group like `--upper/--lower` with `flag_value` and the same dest. Every such command crashes during parsing.

`same_source` makes a later parameter overwrite the slot, where the old code let the first one win. For two flags sharing a name that both fall back to DEFAULT, with neither or both having an explicit default, the last option now wins. The old rule kept the earlier, non-UNSET value, so the group's default value changes. Overwriting also replaces the earlier value without checking it, which can discard a value set from the command line or an environment variable.
